🎲 3D Timeline Visualization Demo

This demo shows how the new 3D interactive timeline visualization works for the Jetson Containers build dashboard. The 3D view makes it much easier to see individual build instances and understand patterns across multiple runs.

Success - Build succeeded
Failed - Build failed
Timeout - Build timed out
OOM - Out of memory
Started - Build in progress

🎮 How to Interact

  • Rotate: Click and drag to rotate the 3D view
  • Zoom: Scroll up/down to zoom in/out
  • Pan: Right-click and drag to move the view
  • Click Bars: Click on any bar to see which run it represents
  • Hover: Hover over bars to see detailed statistics
  • Reset View: Click the home icon in the toolbar to reset camera

✨ Better Visibility

Each status type (Success, Failed, Timeout, etc.) is on a separate layer, making individual instances easy to see.

🔄 Interactive Rotation

Rotate the view to see data from any angle. Focus on specific status types or time periods.

🎯 Click to Navigate

Click on any bar to jump directly to that run's detailed results and logs.

📊 Clear Patterns

Easily identify trends, spikes in failures, or improvements over time.
